description: This file defines the IGrainDirectory interface and an extension method for grain directory implementations in Orleans by providing method signatures for registration, lookup, and unregistration of grain addresses, along with related comments.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryExtension
classes.description: Contains a static extension method for GrainDirectory registration handling.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Attempts to register a GrainAddress in the directory, potentially unregistering a previous address.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a specified GrainAddress from the directory.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Retrieves the GrainAddress associated with a given GrainId.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Removes all entries associated with the specified silo addresses.
